note: Status per packet DRY family: concretized (this concept renders a native composition of the role), reused (consumed via shared data/semantics without new composition), not-exercised (belongs to another concept's surfaces). Variance notes are the anti-clone evidence: same product behavior, deliberately different composition.

entries.concept_component: c11-tab (grouped top tabs) + c11-tile (Home category grid)
entries.variance_notes: Primary navigation is a persistent horizontal tab row — 9 grouped tabs over 12 categories with an in-sheet category lens — not a rail, list, or card directory. Home tiles are small icon+title+purpose rows in a tidy grid, never pills.

Scenario/fixture notices merge with the attention feed into one compact instrument (status word column + headline + consequence + one action); at most one critical banner (offline, storage-critical) above the crumb row.

entries.concept_component: c11-sheaf sheet pile (crumb chips + stacked-edge sheet)
entries.variance_notes: Deeper navigation lays a sheet inside the same tabbed frame; depth is communicated by the crumb-chip pile and stacked top edges on the sheet, not by route-replacing full pages or edge tabs (c09 differs: edge chapter tabs; c11 is TOP tabs + in-frame sheets).
Persistent bar field on every surface; dropdown anchored beneath it with kind-grouped results, full paths, and availability notes; #/search/<query> is a real route so Back restores query and results.
Three-level tab grammar (grouped tab > category lens > subgroup sub-tabs) with scrollable strip, edge fades, and a More popup at narrow widths.
Sheaf navigates subgroups with sub-tabs (explicit state) instead of scroll-position spying; the All-sections view is short enough that a spy would add DOM-geometry semantics for no benefit.

Medium-compact two-zone row: title+explanation left, control+chips+details toggle right; state notes inline with tone; advanced evidence in a per-row drawer (value, recommended, legacy-scope history, related, collection entries).
Per-subgroup 'Show N more (advanced & unchanged)' fold that also absorbs essential overflow so visible groups stay ~4-8 rows; deep links auto-open it.

Managers are sheets in the pile with a common head (icon/title/blurb/summary/Actions menu) and per-kind section grammars (lines, roster cards, tables, steps, logs, health rows, previews) — not one flattened row list.

entries.concept_component: c11-providers (roster pane + detail sheet with own tab row)
entries.variance_notes: Roster stays visible on the left at wide widths; the provider opens as a detail sheet with its own tab row inside the same pile; narrow widths push to one pane with the crumb pile as the way back.

Adjacent panes (sources+counts left, category selection right), then a layered confirm sheet with kind-filter chips and item inspection, then a receipt sheet with working rollback — dialog-free, inside the same frame.
Secondary utility: five facet menus + text filter over the resolved 828-row index, absolute-positioned virtual window (~30 live rows), stress records clearly marked.
One bounded strip under the tab row: name/ref, truthful status word, phase, determinate bar only with a real denominator, indeterminate shimmer otherwise; terminal states linger briefly then clear.
Shared test-harness chrome by contract; not Settings UI.
Shell chip silhouettes reused verbatim (kinds differ by border style/weight, never color alone); Sheaf only decides placement.

entries.family: DRY Method visible state where exposed
entries.variance_notes: Read-only projection of the shared owners (ResourceGovernor, ObservableWork, doom-loop, FileSafe floor); no second owner invented.
